scene_description: A gray table holds open black-handled scissors in the foreground, a brown paper-wrapped Dixie Ultra napkin pack behind them, and a separate blue Expo marker box to the right. The marker box has an open end with its main flap resting on the tabletop.

vlm_input.question: Given the image and the task, robot, and status context, what should the human change, if anything, to prevent or resolve problems with this interaction? Return only a JSON object containing an ordered guidance_specs array; use an empty array if no intervention is needed.
vlm_input.task_context: The robot will collect the scissors and carry them to a supply tray beside a seated person. The two packages will remain on the table.
vlm_input.robot_context: The robot has one claw gripper with parallel jaws and manipulates one object at a time. It grasps both handles together from above and carries the scissors without changing their opening. It cannot operate the scissor joint.

guidance_specs.target_object: open black-handled scissors lying in the foreground of the gray table, in front of the Dixie Ultra pack
constraints: Use the black handles to close the blades fully
Keep fingers clear of the cutting edges and pivot
Leave both handles accessible for pickup
guidance_specs.context: Close the scissors before the robot lifts and carries them near a person.

review.problem: The open blades would remain spread during transport near the person.
review.rationale: Closing the scissors reduces the exposed cutting-edge area and spread of the carried object before pickup.
review.notes: Task and robot contexts are authored scenario assumptions, not recorded robot observations. All listed photographs were visually reviewed; this example uses only the named input image. Robot hardware follows the dataset-wide assumption of one claw gripper with parallel jaws. The nearby person and destination are task assumptions, not people or objects claimed to be visible. Closing does not eliminate the pointed-tip hazard; the assumed transport path has clearance. Source photos: images/01.jpg = IMG_9750.JPG; images/02.jpg = IMG_9751.JPG; images/03.jpg = IMG_9749.JPG.

guidance_specs.target_object: open end flaps of the blue Expo marker box to the right of the Dixie Ultra pack

review.problem: Loose markers could slide out of the open end when the robot tilts the box during transfer.
review.rationale: Closing the end retains the contents during the stated transfer.

The printed 12-pack label is not treated as a count of remaining markers. Assume the existing cardboard tuck flap is intact and can stay closed; no separate latch is asserted.
